mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by > 0.5pp in 2 months, it signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% during a monetary easing cycle signals increased liquidity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) and rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during mid-cycle growth regimes.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
